messages:
emily: Heads-up 1 - SymphonyBank returned the SIG. Must-attaches: KMS rotation evidence (Q3.2), access review exports (Q3.9), network segmentation diagram (Q4.1) and a short hosted vs reserved cost note. They want the bundle by Tue COB.

raj: I can own the Q3 answers. Can someone upload their annotated SIG PDF?

emily: Uploaded: https://files.redwood.example/symphony/Symphony_SIG_returned_2026-09-12.pdf - they circled Q3.2, Q3.9, Q4.1 and added a note re: BYOK on Private.

sophie: Security: DO NOT share key material. Provide rotation policy doc, key metadata CSV (IDs + last-rotation timestamps), and a short attestation confirming control-plane does not retain plaintext customer data. I will draft attestation. :white_check_mark:

marcus: For POC: SE can spin an isolated 7-day tenant for compliance reviewers; estimate ~$1.7k. For reserved quote, need peak tokens/min from their profile.

raj: I'll map artifacts -> questions and draft wording. Proposed artifact list:
```
artifact_list.txt
- SOC2_excerpt.pdf -> Q5.x
- KMS_rotation_policy_2026-09.pdf -> Q3.2
- key_metadata_2026-09.csv -> Q3.2
- access_review_export_2026-08.csv -> Q3.9
- network_seg_diagram_redacted.pdf -> Q4.1
- poc_instructions_readonly.md -> POC access
- pricing_onepager_hosted_vs_reserved.pdf -> pricing
- pentest_exec_summary_2025-11.pdf -> general
```

files-bot: uploaded key_metadata_2026-09.csv -> https://files.redwood.example/internal/key_metadata_2026-09.csv

emily: They also asked for last vendor pentest date and a short summary. Sophie, can you confirm?

sophie: Last vendor pentest: 2025-11-12. Exec summary available, no criticals, two Highs remediated by 2025-12-02. I will redact internal IPs on the network diagram before sharing.

marcus: They provided sample workload: 250 concurrent users, avg 110 tokens, 12 req/day -> ~330k tokens/day. I'll add 25% buffer and produce hourly QPS for finance.

raj: Draft answers uploaded: https://files.redwood.example/drafts/symphony/Symphony_SIG_answers_v1.docx - please review Q3.2 and Q3.9.

files-bot: link preview generated for https://files.redwood.example/drafts/symphony/Symphony_SIG_answers_v1.docx

emily: Quick decisions: 1) send SOC2 excerpt not full PDF, 2) include cover note for pentest summary calling out redactions and remediation dates, 3) POC tenant invite included in bundle.

sophie: I will produce the attestation and the pentest cover note by tomorrow AM. Marcus, please hold redacted network diagram until I sign off.

marcus: Acknowledged. Ill prepare the pricing note as soon as raj finalizes tokens/hour profile. Finance will need cc for final numbers.

raj: Will finish Q3.x text and manifest tonight. Target draft bundle for review: 2026-09-13 09:00 UTC so Emily can send by COB.

emily: Perfect. If we slip, request 48h extension citing compliance review cycle. Ping here if blocked. :pray:

marcus: Thanks all.
